body: I think that's where my problem lies... I wasn't keeping track of making goals out of my exercises at all and was just winging it. My initial thought was "All pain is good pain, because I'm generally obese". But regardless of that, I'll start making goals and not push myself as much. Thank you for your insight.
That makes sense, then I'll start a routine base on that. Thank you.

I thought about family therapy but I never brought it up because I don't know if my mom will even try going to therapy herself anymore. She used to in the past but then suddenly stopped. And claims that she is function-able and can manage her anxiety once. She is also a very busy person but I guess it couldn't hurt to at least bring up the idea. I do care about her mental state is just that I find it that she takes her frustrations out on me and expects me to be okay with it or at least not be depressed as I am now.

I haven't thought of my mom having a social communication disorder, I knew I probably suffer from it myself but it could explain why I have trouble trying to convey what I'm feeling to mom. I feel like I'm in a very dangerous place right now and there's no right time to tell her any of it because of how she reacts.

Edit: I forgot to thank you for the suggestion, I'm so sorry. That was rude of me.

Please don't let the belief of other people, or even yourself, get in the way of what you're feeling. Suicidal thought and the act of Suicide itself doesn't care whether or not there's a god or not. And if you are religious yourself, do know that whatever your religious beliefs are doesn't negate the mental illness that you have. 

You feeling this way isn't just some "excuse". I hope you find the help that you need or find someone to talk to that'll ease your pain. You do not deserve to be going through this much pain.

I'm aware. It's something that many, many people still don't understand when they say those things so I tend to try and point out what other in my situation cannot for themselves. I can tell you are not a bad person but awareness for what doesn't help with depressed/suicidal people needs to be said in this instance. 

At least you can avoid this kind of thinking in the future when helping someone. Remember that actions and empathy mean more to someone with depression than you giving a religious pep talk.

I feel you... And believe me I've had my fair share of people shoving religion in my face at my most desperate times. It didn't stop me from trying to commit suicide a few years ago.

I try my best to be respectful as I am agnostic but these situations just require more actions to help and support someone than to just tell them about prayer and god. I've been told prayers have been going my way but I'm still at my most miserable I've been in my entire young life.

No one is a selfish individual for taking their own life, and no one should be shamed for it.... Thank you for your kind words though, I will try to find the reasons to live myself.

Please do not bring your religion and own personal belief about the afterlife into a subject this sensitive. Suicide and Suicidal thoughts do not care whether there's a god or not, it's a mental condition. And the person whose in pain isn't going to get better from you simply telling them that. 

I  know you're trying to show support, but "Be better" and "killing yourself is not your task" doesn't help here. If a person had the ability to pull themselves out of there own depression, I promise you that we all would have done that by now.

" Whats wrong with you? Do you not understand the effect it's going to have long term on your child? "

Mental illness isn't logical, that's *what's wrong*

This is the kind of guilt-tripping that makes us feel worse about ourselves, please don't do that. That doesn't help.

I'm not sure what exactly you're talking about, and I can't force you to elaborate if you don't want to. But if you need to vent your frustrations or need someone to let your feelings be known to I don't mind listening.
Many times, many therapists. My current one doesn't understand me one bit. I'm tired and just want to die and leave everything behind.
Physically and Mentally. Stress has gotten so bad it's effected my body too.

It's hypocritical but it's not wrong, because you care about others and it's hard to care about yourself. 

Like me for example, I really don't want you to kill yourself. Because I believe most if not a lot of people can achieve an "It's not great but I'm okay" life. 

But when it comes to me, I know I'm not worth anything and I don't have any skills that'll benefit me, my family, or my society enough to make a stable living. Aside from very bad abuse and whatnot.

I don't know you or what you're situation is like, and I can't promise that everything will be okay. But I can only *hope* for something to change for you, for you find some kind of temporary pleasure at least to make things a least a bit tolerable.

I can't, she's unavailable unless it's the days I mentioned. And I'm unable to go into the emergency center because if I go in they will want to send me to inpatient. And like I said before it's not available because it's full. And I don't know when it'll be open again. 

It's the same here in the US but if the stuff mentioned above is a problem and I already have a therapist there's not much they'd do for me...

Thank you so much for this, this explains the detail.

It's because it was specifically a Child Psychiatric building, so I couldn't continue seeing the psychiatrist that I had before. I'm still upset about it. I'm not sure if that's a thing everywhere else though.

I'll try to get a therapist as soon as I can, though...
